name: Qiu Jinsha
source:
A high school student with a somewhat rambunctious personality. She's popular among both men and woman at school, yet she still has a self-governing attitude.

Her actual identity is the eldest daughter of a famous family of demon slayers. Despite her family's fame declining, they can still live in very wealthy conditions.

However, she is very light on money, and it seems that it is difficult to find anything that can really arouse her interest...?

[Translated from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1685630/_/]Steam[/url]]
